Hanken Grotesk
==============

Hanken Grotesk is the Quansight brand typeface for body text, numbers and
data visualisation.

Source: https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/hankengrotesk
Upstream project: https://github.com/marcologous/hanken-grotesk

Google Fonts ships Hanken Grotesk as a single variable font. Matplotlib
cannot select weights from a variable font, so the nine static weights here
(Thin 100 to Black 900) were instanced from HankenGrotesk[wght].ttf with
fontTools.varLib.instancer. The glyphs are unmodified.
